consoles.name: Marketing
consoles.who: Skydrop holds your stock in India, confirms every COD order by phone, and delivers through India’s couriers — with returns, tracking and your money itemised in one place.

tutorials.title: Placing an order
tutorials.summary: This is the Skydrop client console. We're going to place an order by hand for a customer in India — who it goes to, what is in it, and what they pay when it arrives.

tutorials.title: Adding a product with variations
tutorials.section: A — Day one: before you can sell anything
tutorials.summary: Now a product that comes in more than one version. In Skydrop, stock is counted against variants — never against the product itself — so getting these right is what makes everything downstream work.

tutorials.title: Uploading orders in bulk
tutorials.summary: Typing orders in one at a time is fine for a handful. For a day’s worth, Skydrop takes a spreadsheet instead.

tutorials.title: Finding your way around
tutorials.section: A — Day one: before you can sell anything
tutorials.summary: You can find any screen, and you know what the five sidebar sections are for.

tutorials.title: Setting up your company profile
tutorials.section: A — Day one: before you can sell anything
tutorials.summary: Skydrop knows who you are, and your logo is on your customers' tracking page.

tutorials.title: Telling us stock is coming
tutorials.section: A — Day one: before you can sell anything
tutorials.summary: You have told Skydrop stock is coming, and you chose the route that decides what you are billed.

tutorials.title: Selling under more than one name
tutorials.section: A — Day one: before you can sell anything
tutorials.summary: Say you sell under two names — your own label, and a boutique brand. Skydrop calls each one a store, and this is how you add the second.

tutorials.title: The delivery fee your customer pays
tutorials.section: A — Day one: before you can sell anything
tutorials.summary: Most customers in India pay cash when the parcel arrives, and part of what they hand over is delivery. This is where you set what that normally comes to.

tutorials.title: Being told before you run out
tutorials.summary: The worst way to find out a product has run out is a customer ordering one. Skydrop can warn you first, and this is where you say when.

tutorials.title: Keeping a product up to date
tutorials.summary: You can change anything about a product except the things that must never change.

tutorials.title: Product photos
tutorials.summary: Your products have pictures, in the app and on the picking sheet.

tutorials.title: Inviting someone
tutorials.section: F — Your team, and your account

tutorials.title: Taking money out

tutorials.title: API keys and webhooks

tutorials.title: Opening a member store

tutorials.title: The price a member store pays

tutorials.title: What Skydrop charges, and what it lets you take out
tutorials.summary: Every wallet has rules behind it — what you can take out, when money reaches you, what is deducted. They are all on one page, and this is it.

tutorials.title: Putting money into your wallet
tutorials.summary: Your wallet pays for deliveries, and it is topped up by bank transfer. The one thing to understand first: recording a transfer here is a claim, not a payment.

tutorials.title: Building a role that fits your team
tutorials.section: F — Your team, and your account

tutorials.title: Selling a client’s stock under your own name
tutorials.summary: A member store sells somebody else’s stock under its own name. Your client holds the goods in our Indian warehouse; we ring the customer, pack the parcel and send it.

tutorials.title: Selling for your store
tutorials.summary: This is your sales portal. Your store sells things, you sell them for your store, and Skydrop does the rest: it holds the stock in India, rings every customer, and gets the parcel to the door.

tutorials.title: Running the Skydrop operations desk
tutorials.summary: This is the staff console: where Skydrop’s own people run the business. Call centre agents, warehouse staff, finance, supervisors.

tutorials.title: Sell into India without being in India
tutorials.summary: You can sell into India. Operating there is the problem: no warehouse, nobody to ring a cash-on-delivery customer before the parcel leaves, no courier account, and no way home for the money.

tutorials.title: Sell it before you buy it
tutorials.summary: You have the customers. What you do not have is stock, the capital to buy it, or anywhere to keep it.

tutorials.title: Sell for a store, from your phone
tutorials.summary: You know how to sell. What you have never had is something to sell that does not cost you money up front.
